I figured it would take a while to get enough activity in this sub that I wouldn't be doing most of the posting here myself. It's taking maybe a little longer than I expected, but that's on me for not promoting it enough. I do greatly appreciate those people who have posted so far.

At the same time I started the sub I also started a Twitter account, figuring I'd just post the same stuff there and then, once the sub had enough other people posting, I could back off the sub and post other stuff on the Twitter account, like commercial games. There are plenty of good games which cost money, I just think for a sub it's better to stick with "free and complete."

Couple things I've learned: Twitter sucks for this. You can't say anything in 140 characters. Also: it turns out that I talk too much. So I started a blog - I think maybe my rambling in the comments is possibly a barrier to people who just want to post games they like and don't want to have to worry about writing an essay. This isn't the right place for me to post my lengthy opinions on game development, or anything else, that's more blog material. So I started a blog. I'll still say something about the games that I post here, but I'll keep it short. There's another Twitter account, but this time it's just working as a notification of the blog posts.

Mentioning the blog every post seems a little self-aggrandizing... I don't know, we'll feel it out. If it annoys people maybe I'll limit it to just those times when there's a lot extra to be said.
